description: This script sets up platform-specific upgrade operations for a particular device (board named 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi') in an embedded Linux environment. It defines functions to enable image metadata checks, verify image support, perform upgrades, copy configurations, and prepare pre-upgrade steps, primarily for the iMX platform.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata verification for specific boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is supported on the current board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade depending on the board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files for the upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs pre-upgrade steps for the system.
